heavy_gates: All existing project checks and final-image tests remain mandatory for the exact SHA. See local-workflows and AGENTS.md. A light receipt never approves deployment.
cleanup: On the current operator computer, immediately after server verification and independent rollback; preserve source, data, volumes and signed deliverables.
automation: Hosted light workflows run on push/PR. The active agent invokes ci.py auto; no always-on Mac runner.
local_executor_owner: current person or agent performing the change/deployment; never depends on the owner Mac
